I implemented the solution entirely in `kindergarten_garden.go` (the test file was untouched, and no new files were needed):

- **`Garden`** — a struct holding a `map[string][]string` from child name to their four plant names, so each garden is self-contained (satisfies `TestTwoGardens`).
- **`NewGarden`** — validates the diagram first: it must start with a newline, contain exactly two rows of equal length, with an even number of cups, and every cup must be one of `G`, `C`, `R`, `V` (covers all five error cases: wrong format, mismatched rows, odd cups, invalid codes). It then copies the `children` slice before sorting alphabetically, so the argument is never modified (satisfies `TestNamesNotModified`), rejects duplicate names, and assigns each child two cups per row in order.
- **`Plants`** — looks the child up in the map and returns their plants in the spec's order (row 1 cup 1, row 1 cup 2, row 2 cup 1, row 2 cup 2) plus an `ok` flag that is `false` for names not in the garden.
